 Yaxel Lendeborg’s Girlfriend Caused Stir With Sizzling Swimsuit Photo
 Chris Rosvoglou 2026년 10월 28일 수 오전 12:30 UTC 0 Golden State Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg is having a prolific start to his NBA career, that’s for sure.
 Lendeborg, 24, was a polarizing prospect heading into the 2026 NBA Draft due to his age. While some fans viewed it as a negative, he’s looked like a seasoned veteran so far for the Warriors.
 On Monday night, Lendeborg flexed his muscles by posting a career-high 31 points and 12 rebounds in a 134-114 win over the Denver Nuggets. 
 “He’s as strong as an ox and skilled,” Warriors coach Steve Kerr said postgame . “You saw tonight. In all the critical moments of the game, we just put the ball in his hands. For a rookie to be that advanced already, it’s extremely rare.”
 Oct 21, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) drives to the basket against Golden State Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg (1) in the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn ImagesKirby Lee-Imagn Images. While Lendeborg is impressing NBA fans on the hardwood this season, his girlfriend seems to be causing a stir online.
 Lendeborg’s girlfriend, Tacarra Shyann, has become an internet sensation over the past week. 
 Advertisement
 “Wow you’re gorgeous,” a fan commented on one of Shyann’s posts.
 “Oh my,” another fan wrote.
 Yaxel doesn’t back down from the competition. 
 Lendeborg clashed with Lakers star Luka Doncic during his regular-season debut with the Warriors. He even called out the All-Star guard immediately after the game was over.
 “I had a lot of respect for him [because] I didn’t really watch the NBA much. I just watched highlights and seen him kill people,” Lendeborg told reporters. “But being in it firsthand and seeing all the whining and complaining, I lost all respect. That was awful. Like me getting frustrated, it’s not about the foul being called, it’s about him complaining the entire game. And then you get the foul call – congratulations. Then you talk to me like you did something great. C’mon, dog. That s— is weak. It kind of threw me off because I have so much respect for him. Gone, man. Gone.”
 We’ll see Lendeborg square off against Doncic this Friday at the Chase Center.
